Question: For a sequence \(u_1,\) \(u_2,\) \(\ldots,\) define \(\Delta^1(u_n)=u_{n+1}-u_n\) and, for all integers \(k\gt1,\) \(\Delta^k(u_n)=\Delta^1(\Delta^{k-1}(u_n)).\) If \(u_n=n^3+n,\) then \(\Delta^k(u_n)=0\) for all \(n\)
